source_text: Immature stages of An. gambiae s.l. were collected from breeding sites in October 2015 in rice fields at the outskirts of the city of Yamoussoukro (6°49′13″ N/5°16′36″ W)... Emerging 3–5 day old adult female mosquitoes were tested for insecticide susceptibility.
